title.rendered: Oracle Support Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Support Engineer 1 Job

content.rendered:
Are you looking to start your career in technical support, troubleshooting, SQL, and cloud technologies? Here is an opportunity worth exploring. Oracle Support Engineer recruitment is open for the position of Support Engineer 1 in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

Oracle is looking for candidates who can assist customers with technical queries, troubleshoot product-related issues, investigate service requests, and work with internal technical teams to resolve problems. This position is suitable for early-career professionals with an interest in database technologies, technical problem-solving, and customer support.

The job listing mentions an experience range of 0 to 2+ years, making it relevant to candidates with limited professional experience as well as those beginning their careers. Applicants should also have good English communication skills and knowledge of SQL, troubleshooting, incident management, and collaboration.

If you are searching for Oracle Support Engineer jobs, Oracle jobs for freshers, or technical support engineer opportunities in Bengaluru, this article covers the complete job overview, eligibility, responsibilities, required skills, and application information.

Oracle Support Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Job Overview

Here are the important details of the Oracle Support Engineer 1 vacancy.

Important: Oracle has not specified a particular degree, graduation batch, minimum CGPA, salary, or work arrangement in the supplied job description. Candidates should check the official job listing for any additional requirements.

About Oracle

<escape>Oracle</escape> is a global technology company that provides database software, cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, and technology solutions to organizations across different industries.

Its products and services support businesses in managing data, developing applications, running enterprise systems, and operating cloud-based platforms.

Oracle also continues to integrate artificial intelligence into its products and services, helping customers improve business processes and use technology more effectively.

For candidates interested in databases, enterprise software, cloud computing, and technical support, working at Oracle can provide exposure to large-scale technology environments and customer-facing technical operations.

Oracle Support Engineer 1 – Job Details

The current opening is for Support Engineer 1, under Oracle’s Services and Support category.

The selected candidate will act as a point of contact for customers who need assistance with Oracle products. The work involves answering technical questions, investigating reported issues, troubleshooting common problems, and coordinating with experienced technical teams when more complex problems arise.

This is an individual contributor position. Candidates will be responsible for their assigned support activities while receiving guidance from senior colleagues when required.

The role also involves documenting technical issues, maintaining service requests, learning how to prepare troubleshooting guides, and using automation tools, including AI assistance, to investigate common problems.

In simple terms, an Oracle Support Engineer helps customers understand and resolve technical issues while ensuring that support requests are handled professionally and efficiently.

Oracle Support Engineer Roles and Responsibilities

Candidates selected for the Oracle Support Engineer position will perform different technical support and customer service activities.

1. Customer Technical Support

One of the primary responsibilities is assisting customers who experience problems with Oracle products.

The support engineer will:

  • Respond to customer enquiries through phone and electronic channels.
  • Understand reported technical problems.
  • Answer product-related technical questions.
  • Troubleshoot simple issues.
  • Help customers find suitable solutions.
  • Maintain professional communication throughout the support process.

Building good customer relationships and providing helpful technical guidance are important parts of this position.

2. Technical Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution

The role requires candidates to investigate technical issues reported by customers.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Understanding the problem reported by a customer.
  • Collecting relevant technical information.
  • Recreating and testing reported issues.
  • Researching possible causes.
  • Identifying suitable resolutions.
  • Supporting basic fix delivery and product certification activities where applicable.
  • Escalating complex technical issues to the appropriate teams.

Candidates should be comfortable following standard troubleshooting procedures and learning how to investigate unfamiliar technical problems.

3. Service Request Management

Oracle Support Engineers also work with customer service requests.

They are expected to follow up with customers, communicate progress, and ensure that reported problems are resolved appropriately.

The work includes:

  • Maintaining service request information.
  • Updating technical documentation.
  • Following up on unresolved issues.
  • Communicating resolutions to customers.
  • Escalating problems when additional technical support is required.

Good organization and communication are important because multiple support requests may need to be handled within defined timelines.

4. Technical Documentation and Knowledge Base

Documentation is another important responsibility of this role.

Candidates will learn to maintain product documentation and prepare troubleshooting guides or Knowledge Base articles.

These documents help technical teams and customers understand common issues and their solutions.

The responsibilities may include:

  • Recording troubleshooting activities.
  • Documenting customer issues.
  • Maintaining service request details.
  • Preparing troubleshooting guides.
  • Creating Knowledge Base articles for resolved problems.

Accurate documentation can reduce repeated troubleshooting work and improve the overall support process.

5. Collaboration With Internal Teams

The selected candidate will work with experienced colleagues and other internal stakeholders.

The role involves understanding customer environments, learning Oracle product ecosystems, and assisting internal teams with different technical situations.

Candidates should be comfortable sharing information, asking questions, receiving feedback, and coordinating with others to resolve problems.

6. Using AI and Automation Tools

One interesting aspect of this Oracle job description is its focus on automation and AI-assisted support.

Candidates will learn to use automation tools and AI assistance to investigate common technical issues and discover their root causes.

They may also identify opportunities to improve existing support workflows, processes, guidelines, and best practices.

This makes the position relevant to candidates who are interested in combining technical support knowledge with modern productivity tools.

7. Performance Monitoring

Oracle expects support engineers to monitor their assigned service performance metrics with some guidance.

This involves completing assigned work, following support procedures, and maintaining the expected quality of customer service.

8. Planning and Task Execution

Candidates must complete assigned tasks within the required timelines and follow instructions when priorities or schedules change.

They should be able to organize their work, monitor progress, and complete responsibilities according to project requirements.

Oracle Support Engineer Eligibility Criteria

Before applying for the Oracle Support Engineer Recruitment 2026, candidates should carefully review the requirements mentioned in the official job description.

Experience Requirement

The job listing mentions:

0 to 2+ years of experience.

This indicates that the position is intended for early-career candidates, including applicants with limited professional experience.

However, Oracle has not explicitly stated that the position is exclusively for freshers.

Educational Qualification

The supplied job description does not specify a mandatory degree or particular engineering specialization.

Candidates should review the official application page for any additional educational requirements.

English Language Requirement

Applicants must be able to read, write, and speak English.

Good communication is important because the role involves direct interaction with customers and internal technical teams.

Required Technical and Professional Skills

Oracle has highlighted the following skills:

  • SQL
  • Troubleshooting
  • Problem-solving
  • Collaboration
  • Incident management and response

SQL, troubleshooting, problem-solving, collaboration, and incident management are the core skills explicitly listed by Oracle. The remaining areas reflect responsibilities described in the job posting.

Is Oracle Support Engineer a Good Opportunity for Freshers?

The Support Engineer 1 position is an early-career role with an experience range of 0 to 2+ years.

This makes it worth exploring for candidates who want to develop their careers in technical support, database technologies, and enterprise software.

Candidates interested in this type of role should be comfortable with:

  • Learning new software and technology platforms.
  • Understanding customer-reported technical issues.
  • Working with SQL and database concepts.
  • Following troubleshooting procedures.
  • Communicating with customers professionally.
  • Collaborating with senior technical teams.

Although the experience range includes early-career candidates, the supplied description does not explicitly confirm eligibility for applicants with zero experience. Check the official vacancy requirements before applying.

Oracle Support Engineer Salary

Oracle has not disclosed the salary or compensation package for the Support Engineer 1 position in the supplied job description.

The actual compensation may depend on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, job location, and Oracle’s internal compensation structure.

Candidates should confirm salary-related information during the official recruitment process.

Benefits of Working at Oracle

Oracle highlights a workplace culture that encourages innovation, professional development, and equal opportunities.

The company mentions competitive benefits that support employees through areas such as:

  • Flexible medical benefits.
  • Life insurance options.
  • Retirement options.
  • Employee development opportunities.
  • Community volunteering programmes.
  • An inclusive working environment.

The exact benefits available may depend on the employee’s location and applicable company policies.

Final Words

The Oracle Support Engineer opportunity is worth exploring for early-career candidates who are interested in technical support, SQL, database technologies, and customer-focused problem-solving.

The Support Engineer 1 position provides exposure to customer technical support, troubleshooting, incident management, documentation, and collaboration with experienced technical teams.

Candidates with 0 to 2+ years of experience, good English communication skills, and knowledge of SQL and troubleshooting should review the complete job requirements on Oracle’s official careers website.

If you are interested in building a career in enterprise technology and technical support, this Oracle opportunity may be a useful step in your professional journey.

title.rendered: Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment – App Dev & Support Engineer I Job for Freshers

content.rendered:
Are you an engineering or computer science graduate looking to start your career in software development, application support, and IT services? Here is an opportunity worth exploring. Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment 2026 is offering an entry-level position for App Dev & Support Engineer I.

Conduent is looking for candidates with strong programming fundamentals, logical reasoning, analytical abilities, and an understanding of software development concepts. Applicants with knowledge of Java, Python, SQL, .NET, C, or JavaScript can check this opportunity.

The position is designed for entry-level applicants who want to build their careers in application development, systems configuration, software testing, and technical support. Candidates with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum 7 CGPA can review the eligibility requirements.

If you are searching for Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment, Conduent jobs for freshers, application support engineer jobs, or entry-level software engineering opportunities, this article covers the job details, qualifications, technical skills, responsibilities, and preparation tips.

Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Job Overview

Here is a quick overview of the App Dev & Support Engineer I vacancy.

Important: The supplied job description does not mention the job location, salary, graduation batch, or application deadline. Candidates should verify these details on Conduent’s official careers website before applying.

About Conduent

<escape>Conduent</escape> is a business process services and technology company that provides mission-critical services and solutions to businesses, government organizations, and other clients.

The company supports a wide range of business operations through technology-driven services and solutions. Its work involves helping organizations manage complex processes, improve service delivery, and create better experiences for customers and citizens.

Conduent highlights the importance of its associates in delivering services for Fortune 100 companies and hundreds of government organizations.

For candidates interested in starting a career in IT, application development, and technical support, this opportunity provides an entry point into a professional technology environment.

Conduent App Dev & Support Engineer I – Job Details

The current opening is for App Dev & Support Engineer I, under the Information Technology category.

This is an entry-level role intended for applicants with strong programming fundamentals, logical reasoning, and analytical skills.

The position focuses on systems configuration and testing related to applications that support different business functions.

Candidates should have a good understanding of programming concepts and be comfortable learning new technologies. The role also requires knowledge of software development principles, databases, and problem-solving techniques.

Unlike a position focused entirely on software development, this role combines application development concepts with systems configuration, testing, and support activities.

Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment – Eligibility Criteria

Candidates interested in the Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment 2026 should carefully review the educational and technical requirements.

Educational Qualification

According to the supplied job description, applicants must have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology.
  • A degree in a related field.

Candidates should have an academic score of 7 CGPA and above from a reputable institution.

The job description does not specify a particular graduation year or academic requirements for Class 10 and Class 12.

Programming Language Requirements

Candidates should have proficiency in at least one programming language from the following list:

  • Java
  • Python
  • .NET
  • C
  • JavaScript
  • SQL

Applicants do not necessarily need to master every language listed. The requirement is proficiency in at least one programming language, supported by a strong understanding of programming fundamentals.

Computer Science Fundamentals

Candidates should have a strong understanding of:

  • Data structures.
  • Algorithms.
  • Object-oriented programming.
  • Programming concepts.
  • Logical reasoning.
  • Problem-solving techniques.
  • Software development fundamentals.

These concepts are important for understanding application behavior, identifying problems, and developing suitable technical solutions.

Software Development Lifecycle

The job description also requires familiarity with Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and best practices.

Candidates should understand the basic stages of software development, including:

  1. Requirement analysis.
  2. Software design.
  3. Development.
  4. Testing.
  5. Deployment.
  6. Maintenance.

A basic understanding of these stages can help applicants understand how software applications are developed, tested, and maintained.

Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment – Salary and Benefits

The supplied job description does not disclose the salary or compensation package for the App Dev & Support Engineer I position.

Candidates should confirm the compensation details during the official recruitment process.

Conduent also highlights a workplace culture where individuality is valued and associates are encouraged to develop professionally.

The company states that it is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants without discrimination based on legally protected characteristics.

Final Words

The Conduent Support Engineer Recruitment 2026 is an opportunity worth exploring for computer science and IT graduates who want to begin their careers in application development, software testing, and technical support.

The App Dev & Support Engineer I position is designed for entry-level candidates with strong programming fundamentals, logical reasoning, SQL knowledge, and an understanding of software development concepts.

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and at least 7 CGPA should review the complete job requirements and check the official careers portal for the latest application status.

If you are interested in building a career in IT, application development, or software support, consider preparing your programming fundamentals and applying if you meet the eligibility criteria.

The position requires 0–2 years of experience in SQL, Python, and data visualization. It is a full-time hybrid opportunity within Citi’s Decision Management and Data/Information Management teams.

If you are searching for Citi Group Hiring Data Analyst, Citi jobs for freshers, SQL Python jobs, or data analyst opportunities in Gurugram, this article covers the job overview, eligibility criteria, responsibilities, technical skills, salary information, and application process.

Here are the important details of this Citi recruitment opportunity.

The company operates across international markets and offers services in areas such as consumer banking, corporate banking, investment banking, treasury, wealth management, and financial technology.

Data plays an important role in modern banking operations. Financial institutions use data analysis, reporting, database management, and visualization tools to understand business performance, monitor risks, and support informed decisions.

Working at Citi can provide exposure to a professional financial services environment where data management and analytical processes support business objectives.

Citi Data Analyst Job Details – What Is This Role About?

The current opening is for a Data Analyst with SQL/Python/Data Visualization under Citi’s Decision Management and Data/Information Management job families.

The position is described as a trainee professional role. The selected candidate will work with defined processes, procedures, and systems while developing an understanding of the broader business environment.

The role involves supporting different data-related activities, including:

  • Data analysis
  • Database administration
  • Data maintenance
  • Data quality management
  • Database management
  • Database architecture and design-related activities

Candidates will be expected to use their technical knowledge to complete assigned work, analyze factual information, and identify suitable solutions to routine problems.

The position also requires attention to detail, professional communication, and an understanding of the importance of risk management and regulatory compliance in banking.

Specific benefits applicable to this particular position have not been listed in the supplied job description. Candidates should refer to Citi’s official employment information or ask the recruitment team for details.

The position offers exposure to data and information management activities within a global financial services organization. Candidates with 0–2 years of relevant experience who meet the educational requirements can review the vacancy and apply through the official recruitment portal.
